title: Engineers report: T-002 Package 1 (T-002a to T-002e, branding and Admin)
summary: Built the Admin persona, company settings and branding for the web app: a public branding endpoint, Admin-only settings (company name, colour scheme) with a server-side contrast rule, the dark green default theme and the Admin settings page. Migrations 0002 (company_settings) and 0003 (admin role). A review round followed (review-t002-pkg1) and its fixes were made: contrast is checked against both white and the surface colour, only U+0020 is trimmed and invisible characters are rejected, demo accounts are refused outside local and test, README and docs updated. Backend 472 passed, Vitest 216 passed at review.

items.text: T-002b: admin role, router-level role guards, create-admin command, per-role landing page.
T-002c and T-002e: PATCH /admin/settings for company name and colours, with the WCAG contrast rule on the server and in the web form.
T-002d: dark green default theme applied through CSSOM custom properties (CSP-safe).
MAJOR: accent contrast now checked on white and on the surface colour (server and contrast.ts), with an e2e axe run on the lowest-contrast accepted accent.
Minors: trimming and invisible characters, create-admin control characters, demo-account guard, README, 360px screenshots.
